question: Using data from ChEMBL Release 23, retrieve all distinct molecules associated with the company 'SanofiAventis,' listing the trade name and the most recent approval date for each molecule. Make sure to keep only the latest approval date per molecule and ensure the company field precisely matches 'SanofiAventis' without relying on other fields.
sql:
WITH sanofi_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ms_res.molregno
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.research_companies_23` rc
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.molecule_synonyms_23` ms_res ON rc.res_stem_id = ms_res.res_stem_id
  WHERE rc.company = 'SanofiAventis'
),
molecule_data AS (
  SELECT md.molregno, md.pref_name, md.first_approval
  FROM sanofi_molecules sm
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.molecule_dictionary_23` md ON sm.molregno = md.molregno
),
trade_names AS (
  SELECT ms.molregno, ms.synonyms as trade_name
  FROM molecule_data md
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.molecule_synonyms_23` ms ON md.molregno = ms.molregno AND ms.syn_type = 'TRADE_NAME'
),
product_approvals AS (
  SELECT UPPER(p.trade_name) as trade_name_upper, MAX(p.approval_date) as latest_approval
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.products_23` p
  WHERE p.applicant_full_name IN ('SANOFI AVENTIS US LLC', 'SANOFI AVENTIS US INC', 'SANOFI-AVENTIS US LLC', 'SANOFI US SERVICES INC')
  GROUP BY UPPER(p.trade_name)
),
molecule_product_approvals AS (
  SELECT tn.molregno, tn.trade_name, pa.latest_approval
  FROM trade_names tn
  LEFT JOIN product_approvals pa ON UPPER(tn.trade_name) = pa.trade_name_upper
)
SELECT md.molregno, md.pref_name, tn.trade_name, md.first_approval, mpa.latest_approval
FROM molecule_data md
JOIN molecule_product_approvals mpa ON md.molregno = mpa.molregno
JOIN trade_names tn ON md.molregno = tn.molregno AND tn.trade_name = mpa.trade_name
ORDER BY md.pref_name
LIMIT 30
